findings.governingReading: A woman of such ominous, malign black that the poisonous red around her seems pale stands before Shirou.
findings.explanation: Woman in black reduces an overwhelming visual presence to clothing color and omits its threatening quality.

findings.highlight: an image of my head being ripped off
findings.evidenceJa: 無惨に殺されている自分の姿
findings.governingReading: Shirou involuntarily imagines himself being brutally killed.
findings.explanation: The adult-content branch invents decapitation, specifying a method absent from the Japanese.
